subsystems.name: Content representation (textrep + aud encoder bridge)
subsystems.evidence: p3: natural English article 330 mean unique viewers vs keyword-stuffed 1,540 vs meaningless hash-selected tokens 3,213/4,000; 32-d noise sd 0.179; synonyms cos -0.22; p1: image publish refused with default encoder; p4: semantic mode maps football text->politics, cooking->cars.

semantic mode projects D's vector with a random Gaussian matrix (audience.py:475) into an unrelated space - multimodal reach is a lottery
subsystems.work_needed: One shared learned/pretrained multimodal space for content and individuals; interests defined in it; validation that behaviour tracks meaning; adversarial token-gaming test.

skeptic.head: dd745b9 (social/ unchanged since a881d18; only acceptance/v5 manifest+requirements differ)
skeptic.method: Attempted to refute every RETAIN and generous verdict and to test harsh ones with self-written runtime probes (single thread); verdicts changed only on probe evidence.

overturned.why: recount() verifies only the in-memory log window: 439 false mismatches after snapshot restore, 643 with log_retain=2000, 0 only when full history is passed from a store (no caller does); no decision provenance (auditor p2); C1 reading unaccounted.

Social pages exist only in the test-built make_social_web_app; the deployable crucible.web.app main (make_web_app) serves generic service-host consoles for social.crucible etc.; no runner/agent uses it.

Identical embedding, 15 vs 600 words: blurb wins unique viewers 1922/1251 vs 1208/532, shares and subscribers; value = frac_read*(affinity-0.2) (consumption.py:379-381) ignores what the reader gains. Mechanics retainable, value model must be redesigned.

Measured only in a C1-only world; with aud distributing pics/pods/shorts under the default encoder, image/audio/video publish is refused (InvalidAction no encoder); works only with the random-projection semantic mode.

Public aud.item events (delivered in every learner's observation, agents/base.py:96-103) carry the platform's exact 32-d emb (diff 5e-7) and terms; from public data an agent's post reached 2,287 vs 320 viewers for a natural article (7x). D.4 scans only 16 config strings.

Too harsh and inconsistent with the auditor's REPAIR verdicts on catalogue/graph: population batch APIs work on population rows (500 joins, 500 follows, 50 leaves; visible in community.view and profile; invariants clean). Missing: population behaviour on platforms + one state truth.
